• Ability to design and should be an independent performer
• Fast Learner
• Ability to collaborate
• Good communication and presentation skills

Preferred:
• AI/LLM development knowledge/Prompt Engineering
• Github CoPilot efficient prompt experience

• CoPilot Studio/Power Platform knowledge, Dynamics 365 CE/Salesforce is similar
